title: [Distributed][PP] only create embedding & lm head when necessary (#6455)
gain_evidence: Testing with `--pipeline-parallel-size 8` showed up to 25% per-rank memory savings for the Llama-3-70B model.

experiments.name: pp_rank_embedding_lm_head_elision
experiments.workload: Author ran Llama-3-70B with --pipeline-parallel-size 8 and measured per-rank memory, observing up to 25% per-rank memory savings by not allocating the embedding / lm head / norm on ranks that do not use them (no absolute GB numbers published).
experiments.note: Diff edits vllm/model_executor/models/llama.py to create VocabParallelEmbedding only on the first (or tie_word_embeddings last) rank, RMSNorm + ParallelLMHead + LogitsProcessor + Sampler only on the last rank, substituting PPMissingLayer elsewhere. Number source: PR body 'Testing with --pipeline-parallel-size 8 showed up to 25% per-rank memory savings for the Llama-3-70B model'; a maintainer (youkaichao) notes the min across ranks drops by roughly one embedding / lm-head layer. No absolute memory figures given.

reported.scope: per-rank GPU memory footprint reduction (not latency/throughput) for Llama-3-70B under 8-way pipeline parallelism; the saving is roughly one word-embedding or lm-head layer per rank
reported.scale_short: Author's ~25% is a per-rank MEMORY saving under 8-way PP, measured as a fraction with no absolute GB; it is a distributed multi-GPU effect, not CPU-reproducible and not a speed gain. TO MAKE 1:1: on an 8-GPU box run Llama-3-70B with --pipeline-parallel-size 8 and compare per-rank allocated memory before/after, confirming the drop equals the embedding/lm-head tensor size.
reported.scale_note: This is a memory-footprint optimization that only indirectly helps throughput (freed memory can hold more KV cache). The 25% is a reported fraction, not an absolute, and only manifests across real PP ranks on multiple GPUs, so it cannot be reproduced on our single-host CPU microbench. Because vLLM takes the min number of blocks across ranks, the effective win is bounded by the per-rank saving the maintainer described.
